title: Says 10 1/2 in. But flat part of plate is only 6 1/2 in, then big up curve! Small plate.
text:
Says 10 1/2 in. But flat part of plate is only 6 1/2 in, then big up curve! Small plate.. I became aware of Corelle a few years ago after my kids where grown, as it is lead and cadmium free mostly!!, and that was what I was looking for everyday dinnerware. These corelle are made in the Usa as the older corelle are, although the original company was sold recently, and some corelle is being made in China. I did order a couple of sets of the newer ones made in China for one of my grandkids. It’s nice but heavier, and not this type of glass that corelle has been known for. It’s pottery.
Also I tried calling the company to ask if it was lead and cadmium free, and could Not get a answer
, they where not Sure!!!!!
I like that this corelle is light weight as I get older, and my grandkids have dropped a couple on my
Wood floor and nothing broke, and there nice in the RV. Good for the micro, freezer, and oven
But I have found out recently the color design is not lead and cadmium free on this where the color design is.
The other problem I don’t care for on this dinnerware is , it says it’s 10 1/2 inch, but in reality the middle part that is flat for food is only 6 1/2 in. Then these plates curve up, and your food is sitting on the curved up part Of your plate, can have lead etc. Also for me, the pattern is pretty busy and food doesn’t look so good on these plates.

product_metadata.title: Corelle Global Collection Vitrelle 6-Piece Dinner Plate Set, Triple Layer Recycled Glass, Lightweight Eco-Friendly Round 10-1/4-Inch Plates Set, Northern Pines
features: 6-PIECE: Set includes (6) 10-1/4-in dinner plates. This set has everything you need for a full table service of 6, and it comes with the classic Corelle style.

VITRELLE EXCLUSIVE: Using up to 80% recycled, pure glass, Corelle's triple layer glass technology provides extra strength durability. It is also lightweight, easy to handle, and allows for compact stacking to save space.

LOW MAINTENANCE: This dinnerware set is designed to provide the best dining experience while requiring low maintenance. Dinnerware set is dishwasher, freezer, microwave, and pre-heated oven (up to 350°F) safe.

CLASSIC STYLE: Add some style to your eating experience, and make your dinnerware the topic of conversation. This set features hand sketched leaves in shades of blue and teal, inspired by Scandinavian minimalism.
LIMITED WARRANTY: This item has a 3-year limited warranty.
TIMELESS BEAUTY: Crafted with pride in Corning, New York, Corelle Dinnerware are a staple of modern eating for everyday occasions, filling hearts and tables since 1970.
